releases.synopsis: Hailed as one of the best sci-fi novels of the decade, Dark Matter is a story about the road not taken. The series follows Jason Dessen, a physicist, professor, and family man who – one night while walking home on the streets of Chicago – is abducted into an alternate version of his life. Wonder quickly turns to nightmare when he tries to return to his reality amid the multiverse of lives he could have lived. In this labyrinth of mind-bending realities, he embarks on a harrowing journey to get back to his true family and save them from the most terrifying, unbeatable foe imaginable: himself.

releases.title: Anna Pigeon
releases.synopsis: Anna Pigeon is a former city slicker who became a park ranger after a devastating loss changed the trajectory of her life forever. releases.title: Fightland
releases.synopsis: Fightland follows a disgraced, formerly incarcerated boxing champion who returns to London to seek vengeance against the crime family he thinks betrayed him. With edge-of-seat action and populated by dangerous characters, this is a world of money and power never seen before.On the night Duke Kilroy becomes world heavyweight champion, a vicious assault leaves his brother, Calvin, dead, causing Duke to snap and results in him spending eight years in a U.S. prison. Upon his release, and after having made a sinister discovery, Duke returns home seeking vengeance against the man he believes set him up -- the criminal kingpin and former promoter, Kingsley Marshall. But Kingsley has vanished, leaving his children and wife, Joy, who happens to be the love of Duke's life, to pick up the pieces.Working with a cartel desperate to control London's drug market, Duke begins a high-risk game of infiltrating Kingsley's empire to destroy it from within and smoke out his enemy. But amidst a volatile criminal landscape, and competing influences threatening to pull him off course, Duke will need to channel everything that made him a champion fighter into his bloody pursuit to win the ultimate victory - revenge for his brother.

releases.title: Mad Money
releases.synopsis: Mad Money is an American finance television program hosted by Jim Cramer that began airing on CNBC on March 14, 2005. Its main focus is investment and speculation, particularly in publicly traded stocks. In a notable departure from the CNBC programming style prior to its arrival, Mad Money presents itself in an entertainment-style format rather than a news broadcasting one. Cramer defines "mad money" as the money one "can use to invest in stocks ... not retirement money, which you want in 401K or an IRA, a savings account, bonds, or the most conservative of dividend-paying stocks." Mad Money replaced Dylan Ratigan's Bullseye for the 6 p.m. Eastern Time slot. On January 8, 2007, CNBC began airing reruns of the show at 11 p.m. Eastern Time, on Monday through Friday, and at 4 a.m. Eastern Time, on Saturdays.In March 2012, the program became a part of what was formerly branded as NBC All Night in the nominal 3:07 a.m. ET/2:07 a.m. timeslot on weeknights, replacing week-delayed repeats of NBC's late night talk shows. In that form, only the video for the program was presented on a 16:9 screen with gray branded windowboxing andpillarboxing, with all enhanced business information, including the CNBC Ticker, removed. Because of the scheduling of local station's 4 a.m. or 4:30 a.m. newscasts to airEarly Today depending on how a station schedules its overnight programming (even if it airs at the regular time in the Eastern and Pacific time zones for instance, seven minutes would have to be cut-off to fit in Early Today and a local newscast starting at 4:30 a.m.), it is subject to local pre-emption, including by NBC O&O's.On August 4, 2014, Mad Money was first broadcast in full 1080i HD, resulting in the removal of the sidebar that was seen on all of CNBC's other trading-day programming, until the sidebar itself was permanently removed altogether on October 13, 2014. The NBC presentation displays the native widescreen HD picture, albeit with the CNBC Ticker space still filled in with gray windowboxing.

Interviews and debates will highlight leading lights from the left and right, complemented by archival footage from the original Firing Line to remind viewers of longstanding conservative and liberal arguments, where they've been disproved or reinforced over time.

releases.title: GMA3

releases.title: 5 News at Lunchtime
releases.synopsis: The latest national and international news, sport and weather.

releases.title: Большое шоу
releases.synopsis: This is Azamat Musagaliyev's Big Show! Ten famous people are competing for a cash prize. The task is simple - DO NOT LAUGH! Who fails - out of the game. The last one, gets everything.

releases.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe
releases.synopsis: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe covers all the breaking business news and top stories in the lead-up to the opening of the European markets!

releases.title: FOX & Friends First
releases.synopsis: Kicking off the day, FOX & Friends First delivers all the headlines viewers may have missed overnight, along with a preview of upcoming news events. Presented two hours before FOX & Friends, the first hour of the program is hosted by Todd Piro and Carley Shimkus

releases.title: Making Money with Charles Payne
releases.synopsis: Long-time Wall Street broker and analyst Charles Payne hosts his own daily program Making Money with Charles Payne that helps viewers spot emerging investment prospects. A panel of business and market specialists joins him to discuss the latest headlines, wrap up the day's activities in the markets, and focus on tomorrow's moneymakers. Payne says, "There are money-making opportunities behind every headline." His goal is to help viewers "find their confidence in the markets and realize their long-term dreams and goals."

releases.title: CNN NewsNight with Abby Phillip
releases.synopsis: In CNN NewsNight with Abby Phillip, she delivers a thoughtful, sharp approach to the day's biggest stories.

releases.title: Live From The Lycett Arms
releases.synopsis: Joe Lycett presents comedy, celebrity chat and chaos from his own pub, open for only one hour a week on a Friday night, with a guest manager on hand to keep things ticking over as well as guests from the world of comedy, star-studded punters and other regulars.

releases.title: Summertime
releases.synopsis: Cha Do-hyeon and Yeo Eun-ho are neighbors and best friends who have grown up together, inseparable for 19 years. Eun-ho has always believed they are closer than family, never realizing that Do-hyeon's longtime crush has already gone far beyond friendship. When a transfer student suddenly enters their lives, jealousy and possessiveness push Do-hyeon to lose his composure. As his most familiar friend begins acting strangely, Eun-ho is forced to reconsider what their relationship really means. This summer, will 19 years of feelings finally cross the line?

releases.title: The Last Oath
releases.synopsis: A zombie virus sweeps across the globe, and Lin Zai tragically discovers he carries an immunity, making him targeted by multiple factions. A-Leh, a cold-blooded assassin, is ordered to hunt him down, but when he is critically wounded, Lin Zai saves his life, and the two end up bound to each-other in a post-apocalyptic world.

releases.title: El Señor de los Cielos
releases.synopsis: Set in the 1990s, these are the life and times of Amado Carrillo Fuentes, a man who became the head of the Juárez cartel. Nicknamed “El Señor de los Cielos” (Lord of the Skies) because of the large fleet of airplanes he used to transport drugs, he was also known for washing more than $200 million through Colombia to finance his huge fleet. He is described as the most powerful drug trafficker of his time.

releases.title: The Briefing with Jen Psaki
releases.synopsis: Based in Washington, D.C., The Briefing with Jen Psaki will pull from Psaki's decades-long experiences on campaign buses, in the Oval Office, at the State Department, and in the briefing room to dissect the most important stories of the day. Every day the show will aim to help viewers better understand the happenings in Washington and around the country, how it impacts their communities, and what leaders are doing to stand up for the people they represent.

releases.title: Ash
releases.synopsis: Undercover officer Mo Feihuan unexpectedly crosses paths with Xu Luetao, the CEO of Tianping Group. Drawn together by fate, both men hide behind carefully crafted masks and dangerous secrets. As their true identities are gradually revealed, sweetness turns into suspicion, and even the deepest devotion seems destined to fail. A single careless remark from Xu Luetao shatters their fragile bond. Meanwhile, a major cross-border counterfeit operation exposes a brutal power struggle among local forces, drawing both the underworld and the police into a deadly game. Caught in the eye of the storm, Mo Feihuan and Xu Luetao find that the only person they can truly trust is each other. With every step leading deeper into danger and every moment apart deepening their longing, they stand together against overwhelming odds. Though divided by opposing worlds, their hearts remain destined for the same path.

releases.title: Connecting to You
releases.synopsis: Jia Kai has the superpower of seeing the different coloured threads of connection between people but has no connection to anyone himself until a chaotic incident, he meets a policeman named Da Wei and realizes that one silver-grey thread has grown from him to him, connecting them together! Jia Kai doesn't want to lose the connection, so he takes a part-time job at the police station to get closer to Da Wei. With his superpower, he helps with cases of missing people and objects. They get to know each other better, and the thread between them begins to change color, from silver-grey to yellow, representing friendship, and even to red, representing love. Seeing these changes, Jia Kai realizes that how they feel for each other can't be hidden anymore...

releases.title: The View
releases.synopsis: ABC Daytime's morning chatfest, currently featuring Whoopi Goldberg, Joy Behar, Sunny Hostin, Sara Haines, Alyssa Farah Griffin, and Ana Navarro discussing the most exciting events of the day. Hot topics in the news, the best experts in their field, celebrity interviews and general entertainment are all part of The View.

releases.title: WWE Friday Night SmackDown
releases.synopsis: The superstars of World Wrestling Entertainment's "SmackDown" brand collide each and every Friday on WWE Friday Night SmackDown.

releases.title: The Pulse
releases.synopsis: Francine Lacqua provides commentary and analysis on the developing stories from around Europe along with a look-ahead to what's likely to dominate the US business agenda.

releases.title: Varney & Company
releases.synopsis: Varney & Company is hosted by veteran business journalist Stuart Varney, noted for his distinctive British accent, hosts this weekday morning program on which he and his guests discuss the implications of political news on the business world, and also how the news of the day affects personal finances. The company Varney keeps includes regular contributors Charles Payne, Sandra Smith and Elizabeth MacDonald, who weigh in on such issues as government spending, health care and bailouts.

releases.title: Scènes de ménages
releases.synopsis: Scènes de ménages depicts the daily lives of several couples from different generations, illustrating with humor their arguments, tender moments and little idiosyncrasies. Each episode is made up of short sketches, in which the characters exchange scathing retorts and funny situations.

releases.title: Fast Money
releases.synopsis: Fast Money is a lively hour of exchange and debate takes place among four of Wall Street's leading traders. Segments include a look at the day's business-related stories in Page Two; the Takedown, in which panelists disagree and argue their points; the Chart of the Day, which offers a look at the stock of the day; and Trade School, in which host Melissa Lee defines Wall Street jargon used by a panelist or a guest.

releases.title: Bloomberg Markets: Balance of Power
releases.synopsis: In Bloomberg Markets: Balance of Power, host David Gura focuses on the politics and policies being shaped by President Trump's administration.

releases.title: The Source with Kaitlan Collins
releases.synopsis: The Source with Kaitlan Collins - Kaitlan Collins chases the facts, asks the tough questions, and connects with her sources in primetime.

releases.title: 5 News at 5
releases.synopsis: National and international news.

releases.title: Crowned in a Hundred Days
releases.synopsis: After a tragedy destroys his life, a humble diner owner swallows the soul of the true king to gain extraordinary powers. With exactly one hundred days until his own soul is consumed, he embarks on a dangerous quest to defeat a tyrannical usurper, overthrow corrupt conglomerates, and help his host reclaim the throne.

releases.title: Fast Money Halftime Report
releases.synopsis: The hot trades in the market from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange.

releases.title: Power Lunch
releases.synopsis: Power Lunch takes you through the heart of the business day, focusing on real-time market coverage, breaking news and up-to-the-instant stock information. The show delves into the economy, the markets, real estate, media and technology -- any place where there's money to be made. The program features daily contributions from the Nasdaq MarketSite's Times Square studio and coverage from CNBC's Post 9 position on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange, as well as from CNBC's bureaus around the world. "Power Lunch" showcases the best stories of the day from CNBC's roster of digital and television journalists.

releases.title: Blue Peter
releases.synopsis: Join Abby, Joel, Shini, Hacker T Dog and pet Henry on epic challenges and exciting adventures as we inspire you to try awesome new activities and earn your Blue Peter badge.

releases.title: Squawk Box
releases.synopsis: Squawk Box is a business news television program that airs at breakfast time on the CNBC network. The program is currently co-hosted by Joe Kernen, Rebecca Quick, and Andrew Ross Sorkin. Since debuting in 1995, the show has spawned a number of versions across CNBC's international channels, many of which employ a similar format. The program title originates from a term used in investment banks and stock brokerages for a permanent voice circuit or intercom used to communicate stock deals or sales priorities; it also may refer to the squawk of a bird, like a peacock, which is the logo of CNBC.

releases.title: Squawk on the Street
releases.synopsis: Squawk on the Street is headquartered live on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange. We are there when the all-important opening bell rings every day. With our exclusive "Eye on the Floor" wireless cameras at the NYSE we take the viewer onto the floor of the exchange, right to the posts where the biggest companies in the world trade. In addition, our exclusive "Tick by Tick" charts track the action of every trade of every stock. Our live market coverage doesn't stop on the corner of Wall and Broad Streets in lower Manhattan. We also have exclusive coverage from the floor of the CME Group in Chicago giving our viewers the treasury, currency and commodity action in real time. In addition, "Squawk on the Street" is also on the air when the closing bells ring throughout Europe. That final hour of European trading starting at 10:30am eastern has proven to be very volatile and has a major impact on all U.S. based markets.

releases.title: Closing Bell
releases.synopsis: Anything can happen between the bells of the trading day. But what happens during the last hour could be what matters most. Hosted by CNBC's Scott Wapner, "Closing Bell" guides you through the most important hour of the trading day. The show takes a close-up look at how the markets are moving, what's driving them and how investors are reacting.Live coverage includes reports from the Chicago Board of Trade, New York Mercantile Exchange, NASDAQ and the NYSE. Analysts, money managers and CEOs explain their strategies, share opinions, and provide an inside perspective on breaking news stories.In addition, "Closing Bell" provides instant analysis of corporate profit reports, as soon as they break, during the quarterly earning seasons. Features include interviews with entrepreneurs, plus an inside-look at how executives and high-net-worth individuals spend their time and money.

releases.title: Masters of the Universe: Tales from Eternia
releases.synopsis: The series introduces a new generation of young fans to the iconic world of Masters of the Universe through fast-paced, action-packed mini adventures. Tales from Eternia delivers high-stakes clashes between He-Man, Skeletor, and Eternia's iconic heroes and villains, bringing the timeless conflict between good and evil to life for today's audiences.

releases.title: NBC News Daily
releases.synopsis: NBC News provides viewers with up-to-the-minute national and international news.

releases.title: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab
releases.synopsis: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab follows long-term couples whose relationships have been rocked by infidelity as they move into the Miami-based "Cheathab House" to confront the trust issues, jealousy, and unresolved wounds threatening their futures. An emotionally charged journey of accountability, difficult choices and redemption.

releases.title: Klara
releases.synopsis: The crazy girl involved in an affair with a married man? Drinking, smoking and taking pills? Partying with her friend Wronka? Talking to her cat? Arguing with her eternally dissatisfied mother? Klara who has no husband, children or dog? Klara who can't sleep, Klara, who is many years old and has little time, Klara, who is a little afraid but has great courage to live, Klara, for whom love is more important than reason, and good sex is more important than a good name? Klara's Great Return!"

Join the debate, dissemination, and discussion around some of the most market-moving and complex stories of the moment and insights into making you money work around the news.

releases.title: The Football Interview

releases.title: Abyss

Many plot points bear a striking resemblance to a cold case from years ago that has never been made public. Li Cheng, a passionate and righteous rookie police officer, engages in a series of high-stakes battles of wits with various suspects. He unravels the mystery, revealing the truth buried beneath heartbreaking kinships and friendships.

releases.title: Chronicles of the Sun

releases.title: Cold Hunt

During the investigation, he unexpectedly uncovers a lead connected to an armed robbery case he handled 13 years ago. Together, the two cross a 13-year gap, unfolding a hard-boiled manhunt across dual timelines.

releases.title: TFI Unplugged
releases.synopsis: With the biggest bands performing exclusive intimate sets and unfiltered conversations with A-list celebrity guests, TFI Unplugged is the place where anything can happen. Chris Evans reinvents your favourite television institution for 2026.

releases.title: Fired Up!
releases.synopsis: Chou Lu-yung sets out to uncover the truth behind his father's death while managing the family restaurant, "Chin Lai Hao." He faces life's challenges with his close friends and vows to seek justice for his father.

releases.title: The Producer
releases.synopsis: When an aspiring music producer teams up with a veteran mogul, the unlikely duo sets out to conquer the Mandopop scene.

releases.synopsis: This television drama series is centered around the prestigious culinary school of renowned chef Auguste Armand. The show follows the lives of students and staff as they navigate the challenges and pressures of the culinary world—delving into their personal and professional lives, revealing secrets, rivalries, and complex relationships.

releases.title: TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle

releases.title: The Moment with Katy Tur

releases.title: The Weeknight
releases.synopsis: One-on-one conversations with politicians and newsmakers, and the breaking issues of the day.

releases.title: In My Prime
releases.synopsis: In the early 1980s, in the small town of Qingwu, the Qi and Cao families with vastly different family dynamics each welcome a new baby: Qi Shi and Cao Xin. Qi Shi, who suffers from albinism, is acutely aware of her difference from a young age, resorting to drinking soy sauce and wearing wigs in a desperate attempt to fit in. Meanwhile, Cao Xin is the quintessential perfect child in other parents' eyes—yet his reputation comes at the cost of his father's harsh demands. When the unconventional, brave, and stubborn girl crosses paths with the well-behaved, disciplined, and high-achieving boy, the two families—already close neighbors—find their lives intertwined through an absurd swapped-at-birth incident. This sparks a journey filled with tears and the chance for rebirth. As the younglings navigate the trials of family, friendship, and romance, the grown-ups grapple with their career, marriage, and family life. In the torrent of time filled with ups and downs, they heal and grow hand in hand, striving to find their calling and true happiness."In My Prime" is a period family drama series adapted from Han Shisan's novel "Close Neighbors (Jin Lin)."

releases.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
releases.synopsis: Everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Kriti Gupta.

releases.title: Mornings with FOX Business
releases.synopsis: This early show that features a roundtable of rotating industry experts alongside the host. Guests discuss news stories -- domestic and international -- and other topics that are expected to impact the economy and markets that day. The show's intent is to give viewers a jump-start on making moves to get the most out of their investments.

releases.title: CBS News 24/7
releases.synopsis: Live news and top stories on CBS News 24/7.

releases.title: ABC Prime with Linsey Davis
releases.synopsis: Providing prime-time context and analysis of the day's top stories, as well as in-depth reporting and storytelling from around the country and the globe.

releases.title: Against the Current
releases.synopsis: Shen Jia Lan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jin Qi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jin Qi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

releases.title: Current with Christine Romans
releases.synopsis: As markets open and the day's biggest stories take shape, anchor Christine Romans will translate breaking developments, politics, global news and the economy to help viewers stay informed and understand what's next. The two-hour program will also feature segments on finance, business, technology, AI and other consequential topics, leveraging Romans' role as NBC News' chief business correspondent.

releases.title: Fragments of Truth
releases.synopsis: Orphaned at a young age, Han Ning loses his sister in a bizarre kidnapping case. Determined to seek justice, he becomes a detective, using his natural profiling talent to catch criminals. When a strange murder takes place, it triggers a chain of subsequent homicides, and every single case is somehow tied to the unsolved disappearance of Han Ning's sister seven years ago...

releases.title: Humoretaten
releases.synopsis: Eight comedians come together to make you laugh, with skits about current events and life itself.

releases.title: No.9 Hunter
releases.synopsis: Since time immemorial, the Sky Rift has unleashed demonic chaos upon the mortal world. Shangguan Ziyan, a young demoness, and Yuanchu, a Taoist priest, are brought together by fate. As the two No.9 Hunters, they set out on a journey to mend the heavens. Ziyan is afflicted with the Stone Curse, which constantly reverses her yin and yang, shifting her between male and female. Yuanchu, meanwhile, is bound by a cruel fate: whom he loves shall perish. Through all their encounters with humans and demons alike, they come to realize that only their love can serve as the thread to patch the sky and save the world.

releases.title: TMZ
releases.synopsis: Based on the popular gossip website, this entertainment newsmagazine delivers daily updates on Hollywood's rich, beautiful and screwed-up. The program often shows highlights of the day's staff meeting during which reporters pitch ideas for stories to air that day.

releases.title: State of Play with Peter Alexander
releases.synopsis: State of Play focuses on authoritative and original reporting, thoughtful conversations, and in-depth analysis of the biggest political and national stories shaping the day,

releases.title: On the Line with Alicia Menendez
releases.synopsis: On the Line with Alicia Menendez moves beyond the headlines to examine the stories shaping the nation, featuring one-on-one conversations with newsmakers and a focus on voices often left out of the political discourse

releases.title: Bloomberg: The Close
releases.synopsis: Alix Steel, Romaine Bostick and Scarlet Fu own the market-moving breaking news around the closing bell; a synthesis focusing on the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street.

releases.title: The Long Watch
releases.synopsis: A major leak case around the turn of the century strikes at the heart of cross-strait dynamics, masking a sharp battle between foreign operatives and our own forces along the covert front. In the late 1990s, an unlikely mentor-apprentice duo at Minzhou's State Security Bureau, with starkly different temperaments, are thrown together by fate to serve the same mission and faith. They manage to thwart multiple schemes, but their lives remain tangled with their enemy across a twenty-year span. As the new era reshapes the balance of power in national security, the hidden war continues without pause. Again and again tested by human nature, the three see their bonds and destinies silently transformed by the choices they make through time.

releases.title: Suidooster
releases.synopsis: Suidooster is a South African television soap opera produced by Suidooster Films which revolves around a matriarch, her family, friends and the people of Suidooster, a small shopping and business centre in the fictional Cape Town suburb of Ruiterbosch.

releases.title: LIVE with Kelly and Mark
releases.synopsis: A morning talk show with A-list celebrity guests, top-notch performances and one-of-a-kind segments that are unrivaled on daytime television, plus spontaneous, hilarious and unpredictable talk.

releases.title: The Story Is with Elex Michaelson
releases.synopsis: The Story Is will feature live nightly panels and debates on set featuring a range of voices including attorneys Gloria Allred and Areva Martin, conservative talk radio hosts Larry Elder and Jennifer Horn, progressive podcast host Brian Tyler Cohen, former California GOP chair Jessica Millan Patterson and journalists Peter Hamby from Puck and POLITICO's Melanie Mason.

releases.title: The Faulkner Focus
releases.synopsis: Emmy-winning journalist Harris Faulkner provides the latest news driving the day with insightful analysis and interviews with top newsmakers.

releases.title: The Will Cain Show
releases.synopsis: Featuring conversations with newsmakers from across politics, business, culture and sports, The Will Cain Show will offer a comprehensive look at the news of the day in a signature podcast style.

releases.title: America Reports

releases.synopsis: Anchor Kelly Evans reports on the most important stories to today's markets and investors.

releases.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily

releases.title: Fox News @ Night
releases.synopsis: Fox News @ Night is a live hour of hard news and analysis of the most compelling stories from Washington and across the country.

releases.title: Forræder
releases.synopsis: An entertaining crime mystery with 18 players and a game director. Who can see through lies? Who is the best tactician in the game? And who will end up with the entire prize pool? Only one thing is certain: Trust no one!

releases.title: The Mad Monk: Subdue Demons
releases.synopsis: The Mad Monk wanders the mortal realm, guiding and saving those in need, only to find himself trapped in a fateful love tribulation. When he reunites with a woman from his past, the two are drawn into a tangled struggle of love and hatred as demonic forces unleash chaos upon the world. Between the playful daily life of Lingyin Temple and a deadly clash between the divine and the demonic, he must see through greed, anger, delusion, and delusive thoughts. Amid joys and sorrows, partings and reunions, he battles the forces of evil to restore peace to the mortal world.

releases.title: Sword God
releases.synopsis: Chief disciple Zhao Feiyang possesses the legendary "Nine Heavens Codex." When the Nether Hall wipes out the Heavenly Sword Sect, his meridians are shattered, and his fiancée even rips out his Dao bone and breaks off their engagement. At his darkest hour, he saves Bai Xi, an ancient demon saint, who grants him a saint-grade Dao bone, allowing him to cultivate again. Rising at an astonishing pace, he sets out to settle his old scores and found his own sect. A demonic sword recognizes him as its master, and even Earth Immortals submit to him. When the great tribulation finally descends, Zhao Feiyang stands defiant against fate and declares, "If Heaven demands that I face this tribulation, then I'll stain the heavens with blood!"

releases.title: Tut Elimi
releases.synopsis: Their paths crossed as children. Years later, a tragic incident brings Aslan and Elvan together again, forcing them into a marriage of convenience built on sacrifice and duty. At the same time, the heroes must contend with the intrigues of their relatives and pressure from influential circles.

releases.title: The Necromancer! I Am A Disaster
releases.synopsis: The game has crossed into reality, and the old rules no longer apply. Humanity enters an age where anyone can awaken a class, but the opportunity draws unwanted attention: demons from the abyss and the dragonkin both want this new world, and neither is willing to share it. Lin Moyu wakes up in this world with the one class no one else has: Necromancer. His talent is unmatched, his ability system unlike anything else in play, and he grows stronger with every fight, building an army out of the dead until he no longer needs anyone else at his side. As the Shenxia Empire's last line of defense against the abyssal invasion, he becomes the one man capable of breaking the deadlock between humans, demons, and dragons, and the one who ends up standing above all three.

releases.title: The Evening Edit
releases.synopsis: Host Elizabeth MacDonald interviews industry experts to get the inside scoop on the day's leading headlines as they relate to your wallet.

releases.title: Side by Side With You
releases.synopsis: Li Du grows from an aimless man into a responsible husband with Yang Ce's encouragement, and they find lasting love.

The program focuses on business and political news, featuring the "Nightcap" roundtable segment from her previous show, The 11th Hour

releases.title: ABC News Live

They'll even be joined by their friend April O'Neil, and encounter foes like Bebop, Rocksteady, and Karai.

releases.title: 10's Late News
releases.synopsis: Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

releases.title: Dreams of Freedom

releases.title: The Big Money Show
releases.synopsis: Taylor Riggs, Brian Brenberg and Jackie DeAngelis host an informative and fast-paced hour filled with business topics that impact everyone from Wall Street to the average person.

releases.title: Power of Love
releases.synopsis: A group of competitive women and men come together in The Power of Love to find their dream partner. Every week, some contestants win the weekly prize, while others say goodbye to their dreams of love and the house. Emotional moments, surprises, and exciting challenges await in this thrilling season!

releases.title: Draw This, Then Die!
releases.synopsis: First-year high school student Ai Yasumi lives on the island of Izu Oshima and loves reading manga. releases.title: Mārama
releases.synopsis: 1859. When a young Māori woman is summoned from New Zealand to North Yorkshire, she uncovers her horrific colonial heritage and is compelled to confront and destroy the titled Englishman who devastated her family.

releases.title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
releases.synopsis: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

releases.title: The Remotes
releases.synopsis: A grieving detective finds himself increasingly ensnared while investigating a case involving a sinister navigation app causing physical and psychological debris.

releases.title: Look Back
releases.synopsis: Fourth-grader Fujino is admired for the comics she makes for her school newspaper. Her world is upended when asked to share the space with her reclusive classmate Kyomoto, whose stunning artwork is better than anything she can make. When the girls finally meet, Fujino discovers Kyomoto has been idolizing her from afar all along. Her one-sided rivalry abates, and the two are pulled into an all-consuming love of drawing that carries them into adulthood as aspiring manga artists. The adult Fujino and Kyomoto embark on a shared journey where the joys of artistic expression collide with the unpredictability of life.

releases.title: Mindflip
releases.synopsis: Marilyn Hardesty is an aging horror film actress, and heiress to her ancient husband's biotech fortune through a whirlwind courtship, marriage, and funeral. Terminally ill, she is determined to cheat death and rekindle her career by transferring her mind into the body of a younger woman. With Norman Baetz, her "personal assistant", she recruits Dr. Laurence Fine, a brilliant, twisted neurobiologist, to serve her obsession with immortality. With the promise of Reality TV stardom, they lure three young women to Marilyn's remote estate. Ulterior motives unfold. Early experiments prowl the estate. The young women reach a grim realization: escape is the only means of survival. Can they evade Dr. Fine's cut and paste cybernetics? Will Marilyn achieve eternal life or drown in the fountain of youth?

releases.title: Dark Horse
releases.synopsis: Follows Jair Messias Bolsonaro, a man driven by his political career after disappointment with the direction of his country, in the journey to become the 38th president of Brazil.

releases.title: The Nest
releases.synopsis: Marta, a woman so obsessed with protecting her family from outside danger that she decides to keep her mother and young son locked away in an isolated house high in a mountain village.

releases.title: Don't Move
releases.synopsis: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

releases.title: Singh vs Kaur 2
releases.synopsis: Singh vs Kaur 2 is an upcoming Indian Punjabi-language romantic comedy film directed by Navaniat Singh and produced by Gippy Grewal's Humble Motion Pictures and SVF Entertainment. Serving as a standalone sequel to the 2013 film Singh vs Kaur, it stars Gippy Grewal and Shehnaaz Gill, scheduled for worldwide release on 11 September 2026.

releases.title: In Alaska
releases.synopsis: When a suicidal Inuk teen accidentally pierces an oil pipeline with a bullet, the FBI launches a full-scale manhunt across the northern wilderness.

releases.title: Haiwaan
releases.synopsis: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

releases.title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
releases.synopsis: A poetic, emotionally expansive father-son story about Black family, grace, imagination, and the hope that love can transform even the most fragile relationships into something more healing and beautiful.

releases.title: Un renversement
releases.synopsis: This film lifts the veil on the inner workings of women in politics, where everything happens far from microphones and official images. Through intimate and unfiltered testimonies from emblematic Quebec political figures, the film reveals the obstacles, struggles, and power dynamics that mark their journeys, while highlighting those who, despite resistance, forge new paths and redefine the contours of power.

releases.title: The Nation's Gambit
releases.synopsis: Norway's Prime Minister is kidnapped by a terrorist who makes only one demand. That the politicians in power are playing a game of chess over the Prime Minister's life. Each chess piece represents people who work for the state or leaders in society. If the politicians win the game, the prime minister will live, but every piece lost on the chess boards means the loss of a human life. The politicians and their appointed rescue team, the Delta Squad, are faced with an impossible dilemma: Can they afford to sacrifice human lives in an attempt to save the Prime Minister? With only 24 hours to win the game and save the prime minister, they have no choice but to play the deadly game.

releases.title: Let Us Through, Dear Ancestors
releases.synopsis: 1617, Las Islas Filipinas. The Spanish friar, Padre Enciso, the encomendero of one of the islands, rules with unrelenting toughness and an insatiable libido to tame the savages.

releases.title: Tribeca 25
releases.synopsis: 25 years after 9/11, discover how Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal transformed an ambitious effort to revive Lower Manhattan into one of the world's leading cultural institutions. Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, explore how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture.

releases.title: 12 Warriors
releases.synopsis: A dozen top warriors from around the world are kidnapped and forced to participate in fight-to-the-death survival games. Affairs are overseen by a disgraced and sociopathic former Russian intelligence officer who has built a shadowy organization with a clientele of crime bosses, politicians, billionaires, and members of the global elite.

releases.title: Closure
releases.synopsis: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive.

releases.title: Magazine
releases.synopsis: A young intern faces intoxicating power dynamics at a prestigious New York City literary magazine.

releases.title: Morten
releases.synopsis: A coming-of-age tale told in a magical-realism style about a teenage boy, Morten, who feels out of place among his wealthier classmates. While they enjoy expensive school trips, he spends his days in his family’s dilapidated farmhouse, finding solace only in a camera gifted by his grandfather, a lens through which the world seems brighter. When two girls enter his life - Miia, a street artist, and Emilie, a mysterious girl from the marsh - Morten’s world is turned upside down as he struggles to understand both his first stirrings of love and the changing world around him.

releases.title: Mr. Nelson, Did You Kill People?
releases.synopsis: Vietnam veteran Allen Nelson returns with severe PTSD, winding up on the streets before crossing paths with Dr. Daniels of the Veterans Affairs who sets about trying to help him.

releases.title: Jayanti 2
releases.synopsis: When a tribal girl, Payal, is suspended from college for protesting discrimination by her classmates, Santya and Tanuja team up to fight college politics, political pressure, and social ignorance in order to restore her dignity and secure her return.

releases.title: Low Expectations
releases.synopsis: At the height of her music career, Maja falls apart and has to step away from her ambitions. Depressed and broke, she moves back home with her mother and works part-time at a local high school. Far from the spotlight, wrapped in everyday kindness, she slowly finds her way back to life.

releases.title: Chrysalis
releases.synopsis: In war-torn 1970s Vietnam, a resourceful young boy navigates his place in a chaotic world, guided by his grandmother’s wisdom while haunted by memories of his fractured family.

releases.title: Faith
releases.synopsis: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

releases.title: Salvation
releases.synopsis: A tenacious aspiring guru must go to extreme measures to pay off the debts he’s accrued from trying, and failing, to set up an online life-coaching business in a post-industrial Scottish town.  Exploring the world of male influencer culture and how it might be affecting the young men who come into its orbit, SALVATION blends mounting tension, dark comedy and a forensic focus on its protagonist to explore the very modern story of a delusional life coach spiralling out of control.

releases.title: Sunshine Girls
releases.synopsis: SUNSHINE GIRLS follows the story of Elaine, a timid woman nearing her 30th birthday who must make the difficult choice between motherhood and medically induced photosynthesis.  After prolonged environmental destruction, Elaine’s world is experiencing a dangerous shortage of oxygen.  Science has created a solution to this problem: a “minimally invasive” medical procedure that allows women’s reproductive systems to host photosynthesis and cellular respiration, ultimately enabling them to give birth to air.  For the first time in her life, amongst the ragtag troupe of oxygen-producing misfits called the Sunshine Girls, Elaine finally begins to grow into the woman she has always wanted to be...but not everything is always as bright and sunny as it seems.

releases.title: Gator Face
releases.synopsis: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

releases.title: Last Man in Tower
releases.synopsis: Masterji is a retired schoolteacher whose refusal to go along with those around him places him in direct conflict with his own community. His act of quiet resistance ripples outward, throwing into relief the choices and compromises of neighbors – including Mrs. Puri – as an offer of change tests what each of them is willing to hold on to.

releases.title: Glaxo
releases.synopsis: Chivilcoy, 1957. In a quiet Argentinian town, the arrival of an ominous former police commissioner and his seductive wife fractures the bond between four inseparable young men. Decades later, the past resurfaces, forcing them to confront old wounds, guilt, and the possibility of revenge in a country which has lost its innocence.

releases.title: Pradhama Dhrishtya Kuttakkar
releases.synopsis: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

releases.title: Go Team!
releases.synopsis: Gracias, equipo follows a struggling Spanish cheese company whose rural team-building retreat spirals into betrayal and layoffs, satirizing office politics and corporate absurdity.

releases.title: Big Little Things
releases.synopsis: A seemingly perfect middle-class Chinese family faces an unprecedented situation when Lei brings a man home on NYE to pretend to be her boyfriend. Her same-sex girlfriend's unexpected visit intertwined her with a real intimacy crisis.

releases.title: Nino – A Film About Nino Rota
releases.synopsis: An in-depth documentary into the life of renowned Italian composer Nino Rota, who wrote the score for 16 films directed by Federico Fellini, including “La Strada,” “8 1/2,” “Juliet of the Spirits” and “Amarcord,” besides “La Dolce Vita.” He also composed music for Franco Zeffirelli’s “Romeo and Juliet” and the Sicilian-inspired theme for “The Godfather,” whose “Part II” score won him his only Oscar. Rota’s 150 films also included collaborations with King Vidor (“War and Peace”) and Luchino Visconti (“The Leopard”). Rota died at 68 in 1979.

releases.title: Sound! Euphonium: The Final Movie, Part 2
releases.synopsis: The second part of Sound! Euphonium: The Final Movie.

releases.title: What Love Builds
releases.synopsis: Follows Crowe's passion for music and his efforts of maintaining it alongside his acting career, showcasing him and his band on their recent tour in Europe, as well as previous shows in the US, UK and Australia.

releases.title: Back To Buenos Aires
releases.synopsis: It follows Mariano Guerra as he returns to Argentina to testify against soldiers who tortured him during the dictatorship, focusing not on revenge but on his inner struggle with guilt, trauma, and the lasting psychological impact of violence kept largely off-screen.

releases.title: How to Generate a Perfect Crime
releases.synopsis: After his sister, Sara, accidentally kills her threatening teacher in self-defense, Wataru makes a desperate decision to protect her. He uses an AI chatbot to generate a plan for the "perfect crime," staging the crime scene and covering up evidence based on the AI's instructions to make it look like a random homicide.

releases.title: Las 3000 maravillas
releases.synopsis: Pablo, a bit of an oddball – shy and obsessed with analysing the risks involved in any situation – has been waiting a year to attend a massive anime event. When the big day finally arrives, his troublesome brother asks him for a life-or-death favour: he has to go to ‘Las Tres Mil Viviendas’, Seville’s most dangerous neighbourhood, to retrieve a rucksack. Pablo will have to decide whether to put his life on the line to save his brother or attend the event he’s been waiting for all year.

releases.title: America America 2
releases.synopsis: America America 2 is an upcoming Kannada romantic entertainer film directed by Nagathihalli Chandrashekhar. The film stars Nirup Bhandari, Pruthvi Ambaar, and Shanvi Srivastava in the lead roles.

releases.title: Dahaan
releases.synopsis: A malicious ancient spirit is unleashed in a haunted mansion. The girl's elder sister and younger brother team up with a pastor to find a way to end the curse which slowly consumes the girl who opened the box.

releases.title: Intermission
releases.synopsis: Spanning nearly sixty years, Yonfan features his career in music, dance, photography, and writing through fifteen films in Intermission. This captivating cinematic journey stands as a witness to the essence of a changing world.

releases.title: Idda
releases.synopsis: Adele and Sofia, childhood friends now in their thirties, reunite after years apart to fulfill a dream they once shared: reaching the summit of Mount Etna. But something feels off, and a bitter confrontation breaks out, opening old wounds and unveiling deeply buried secrets. They separate just as the volcano begins to tremble. Adele presses on alone, haunted by the wish that she had turned back and reached the crater together with Sofia to listen to the mountain’s magical breathing.

releases.title: Céline Dion : le retour de la reine
Wendochu Alteweledum
releases.synopsis: A Movie By Mubarek Yasin

releases.title: Yuja
releases.synopsis: Daredevil. Rebel. Powerhouse. At 39, Yuja Wang stands among the most electrifying musicians of our time and she is falling out of love with the music. In Yuja, acclaimed filmmaker Lorna Tucker crafts an immersive portrait of an artist in flux. With unprecedented access, the film weaves together performance, memory, and reconstruction to explore the forces that shape Yuja, and the woman she is still becoming.

releases.title: First Person: A Film About Love
releases.synopsis: Stifled by her family life and the stranglehold of feminine expectations, a mother who has it all decides to pursue herself above all else and refuses to bend to society’s mores, even in the face of unspeakable tragedy.

releases.title: Daughters of 9/11
releases.synopsis: Twenty-five years after the deadliest terrorist attack on American soil, Elizabeth Miller, Jessica Trant and FBI special agent Frank Pellegrino confront whether the man accused of masterminding the attacks, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed (KSM), will ever face justice.

releases.title: The Julia Set
releases.synopsis: Julia, a gifted mathematician, navigates the cutthroat world of academia. Pascal, a teaching assistant, recruits her to join an exclusive training program for the prestigious and notoriously difficult Putnam mathematics competition.

releases.title: Mahendragiri Varahi
releases.synopsis: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

releases.title: Lionel
releases.synopsis: Lionel agrees to travel with his estranged father to visit his sister in France, a simple road trip becomes a turbulent reckoning amid unknown roads and unspoken memories.

releases.title: The Face of Horror
releases.synopsis: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

releases.title: Black Sunflowers
releases.synopsis: Black Sunflowers is a mosaic of Ukrainian youth, shuttling between the frontlines and civilian life, captured by the gifted American filmmaker James Marcus Haney (No Cameras Allowed) collaborating with an esteemed Ukrainian crew.

releases.title: Girl Group
releases.synopsis: A pop diva, kicked out of her own group's reunion tour and slapped with a community service court order, seizes the chance to stage a comeback by coaching a group of misfit teen girls for a major record label audition, only to push them too far, forcing her to confront her toxic industry — and her own streak of self-destruction.

releases.title: Knightfall
releases.synopsis: MI5 Weapons Tech Ros Knight finds herself unexpectedly called into a Black Ops mission headed up by her Field Agent boyfriend Hugh. When the mission goes fatally wrong, Ros finds herself on the run with a target on her back and must turn to the only man she can trust, her estranged father – legendary retired spy catcher Charles Knight.

releases.title: The Smell of Apples
releases.synopsis: In the insulated bubble of white Apartheid South Africa, Marnus, a sheltered 11-year old boy accuses the grandson of his family’s domestic worker of steeling his fishing rod. A brutal chain of events is set in motion, shattering the illusion of his family’s wholesome facade.

releases.title: Behuli
releases.synopsis: An emotional family drama about a young woman who lacks the support of her family. She dreams of finding a loving husband who will cherish her, help her build a beautiful life, and give her the freedom to live on her own terms.

releases.title: Blue Baby
releases.synopsis: A specialist nurse is given responsibility for a baby boy with a serious heart condition in the middle of nurses’ strike. She is left balancing between her own family, the baby boy and her loyalty for nurses’ cause.

releases.title: One Cut Monk
releases.synopsis: In a small village in northeastern Thailand, a kind-hearted monk encounters a series of unexpected and chaotic situations during a single-day journey to a local merit-making ceremony. Through humor and warmth, the film reminds us that a positive outlook can help us navigate even the strangest situations in life.

releases.title: Drive Through Fire
releases.synopsis: The story follows an addict war veteran turned rideshare driver who helps a terrified passenger escape a human trafficking ring serving wealthy clients.

releases.title: Lovers in the Blue Night
releases.synopsis: Set against the margins of Mumbai, the film follows four migrants – a gay husband, his wife working in a bar, a thief, and a pimp – whose lives converge around love, survival, and longing

releases.title: Trash Mountain
releases.synopsis: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

releases.title: Beporoya
releases.synopsis: The return of Adrit Roy.

releases.title: Tainted Blood
releases.synopsis: A vampire is overwhelmed by her greed of blood.

releases.title: After Elena
releases.synopsis: When a family's matriarch dies, four relatives are forced to confront decades of silence, resentment, and buried affection. Led by Alfredo Castro, this sharp ensemble balances humour and melancholy in a moving portrait of grief and reconciliation.

releases.title: Pension Patta
releases.synopsis: After his father’s death, Rajan and his mother, Chalu, struggle to claim his pension and repay his debts. A search for a missing name leads Rajan on a journey that transforms him from a greedy young man into a generous one.

releases.title: Wired Together
releases.synopsis: Ivy and Alex are two normal people who happened to fall in love at first sight in the library. Neither of them knew the toll and effect the other's presence, or lack thereof, would have on their life. As they enter the first major challenge of their relationship, long distance, they must accept that sometimes things do change.

releases.title: Dai nostri inviati. La Rai racconta la Mostra del Cinema di Venezia 2001-2012
releases.synopsis: The sixth episode of “Dai Nostri Inviati” chronicles the Venice Film Festival during the early 21st century—from 2001 to 2012—through reports gathered by Rai correspondents: the final year of Alberto Barbera’s first tenure, the two-year term of the late Moritz de Hadeln, the eight years under Marco Müller’s direction, and the first year of Barbera’s second term.

releases.title: Man in Motion: The Rick Hansen Story
releases.synopsis: This galvanizing portrait celebrates Rick Hansen, the great Canadian athlete and activist. It chronicles his 26-month Man In Motion World Tour: a 40,000-kilometre wheelchair journey that raised millions to eliminate accessibility barriers and transform public perception of people with disabilities.

releases.title: ​The Haunted Cat and the Unfolding Petroglyph​
you may be the last witness around okinawa island
Leftover Women
releases.synopsis: Single, childless women turning 35 are to report to government-run centres for assessment and desirability coaching in Atalanta Swire’s wildly entertaining dystopian comedy grounded in Anjana Vasan’s impeccable deadpan instincts as a woman subjected to ludicrous dating exercises.

releases.title: It Came From The Mines
releases.synopsis: Three insensitive students plan to make a documentary on a mine with a tragic past. Despite countless warnings, they fall right into the clutches of what remains inside.

releases.title: Screwy People or: The Pickleball Ordeal
releases.synopsis: A rivalry between two coworkers reaches its breaking point when they find themselves competing for the same promotion. They decide to settle the matter on the pickleball court, but what begins as a simple competition quickly spirals into a bitter battle of hostility, desperation, and increasingly poor sportsmanship.

releases.title: UFOs and God
releases.synopsis: A thought-provoking documentary that examines the modern surge of UFO sightings, government disclosures, and cultural fascination with extra-terrestrial intelligence through a distinctly Christian worldview.

releases.title: Dear Debbie
releases.synopsis:
Sometimes, enough is enough…

Debbie Mullen is losing it. For years, she has compiled all of her best advice into her column, Dear Debbie, where the wives of New England come for sympathy and neighborly advice. Through her work, Debbie has heard from countless women who are ignored, belittled, or even abused by their husbands. And Debbie does her best to guide them in the right direction. Or at least, she did.

These days, Debbie’s life seems to be spiraling out of control. She just lost her job. Something strange is happening with her teenage daughters. And her husband is keeping secrets, according to the tracking app she installed on his phone. Now, Debbie’s done being the bigger person.

She’s done being reasonable and practical. It’s time to take her own advice.

And now it’s time for payback against all the people in her life who deserve it the most.

releases.title: Persona
releases.synopsis:
**A trans woman discovers pornography of herself she has no memory of making, only to find herself led to an unimaginably deeper evil.**

A feral shut-in discovers a disturbing internet porn video of what seems to be herself. A seance of coked-up artists summons unearthly forces in a studio apartment. The staircase of an exurban marketing company descends endlessly beneath the earth. 

In Aoife Josie Clements’ electric, nightmarish, intricately layered novel, the impossibility of goodness crowds in upon two young trans women barely surviving on sex work and zero-hours contracts. Below the familiar evils of capitalism and the bottomless depths of internet culture, a darker horror awaits. What curse follows these women? What are they escaping? What are they running towards?

releases.title: KYOTO lo sguardo del drago
releases.synopsis: Un fantasy thriller, come in un film, dal lusso degli yacht di Portofino ai ruderi di un antico castello in Giappone. Il prezioso pugnale del samurai demone Nobunaga è scomparso. Michele, geniale decifratore di codici segreti, Alexander, affascinante milionario irlandese, Gretel, eclettica signora, e Yoshida, investigatore privato, sono i fantastici quattro che indagano per svelare il mistero in un crescendo da vivere minuto dopo minuto: gli azzardi, i ninja, l'onore e l'amicizia, l'amore e la morte. Tragica e fiabesca, cinica e poetica, una storia dura ammantata di dolcezza ed elegante ironia fino alla spietata soluzione.

releases.title: The Man Who Vanished
releases.synopsis:
**What would you become  if no one could see you?**

A gripping psychological thriller of invisibility, obsession, and power. Deep within Egypt, a discovery changes everything. When I encounter something never meant to be found, my world fractures. I vanish from sight—but not from consequence. Liberation mutates into obsession, freedom into a mind slipping beyond control.

Unseen, I move through the world’s shadows—navigating criminal networks, exposing hidden conspiracies, unearthing truths buried for centuries. Invisibility becomes more than an ability: it becomes temptation, weapon, and curse.

Each step deeper into the unseen erodes the boundaries between justice and transgression, control and compulsion. But the greatest danger is not the enemies I pursue. It is the darkness awakening within me. As curiosity hardens into obsession, morality fractures.

Some hungers leave scars you cannot see. And when power begins to consume rather than empower, survival becomes a battle not only against those who hunt me—but against the consequences of everything I have done. 

The Man Who Vanished is a gripping psychological thriller fused with political intrigue, conspiracies and espionage suspense. Relentless tension meets psychological depth in a story about invisibility, obsession, and the devastating cost of crossing unseen lines.

Perfect for readers who love:

✔ Psychological thrillers
✔ Political and conspiracy thrillers
✔ Espionage and spy fiction
✔ Dark suspense and moral dilemmas
✔ High-stakes international intrigue

Fans of high-tension, mind-bending thrillers and stories of identity, secrecy, and psychological descent will be captivated by its atmosphere, intensity, and escalating suspense. 
Are you ready to vanish into the unseen?

Notice: Contains mature themes and strong scenes intended for mature readers.

releases.title: Titanium, The Life & Memoirs Of Toby Ti Mustard
releases.synopsis: Titanium: Life of X is a raw, visionary memoir by ordained minister and creative leader Toby Ti Mustard. This spiritual autobiography traces a journey of awakening, reincarnation, and resilience — a life forged in silence, shaped by struggle, and elevated by purpose. Set against the backdrop of Ross County, Ohio, Toby’s story unfolds through mystical insight, personal transformation, and a calling to serve. Titanium is not just a book — it’s a declaration of identity, a spiritual blueprint, and a testament to the unbreakable force of becoming.

releases.title: The Beeston Genesis
releases.synopsis: A historical and analytical study examining the role of Robert William Felkin in the formation and codification of modern Western Tarot systems. The paper situates Felkin’s work within the intellectual and social context of Beeston, Nottinghamshire, and traces how these early influences informed later Golden Dawn Tarot structures.

releases.title: My Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Dad
releases.synopsis: This work serves as the primary case study for Sir Jacob Kristopher Anders' research into Digital Provenance and Media Ethics (Ref: Wikidata Q138334536).

releases.title: A Good Person
releases.synopsis:
Lillian and Henry have been enjoying each other’s company, especially in bed. Even though Lillian’s best friend calls it “situationship,” Lillian is determined to lock Henry down—and she has a plan. She’ll be the best, most accommodating version of herself until he falls in love with her. But when Henry blindsides Lillian with a breakup, Lillian exacts revenge by performing a drunken hex on him.

Lillian expects Henry to come crawling back to her. What she doesn’t quite anticipate is becoming a prime suspect in his murder case when he’s found dead. As Lillian grapples with the loss of her sort-of-boyfriend, she’s hit with another reckoning: That Henry had a long-term girlfriend he also left behind.

Desperate to control the narrative, clear her name, and assume her rightful place as Henry’s mourning girlfriend, Lillian’s pursuit of the truth will throw her into a dangerous tailspin.

releases.title: The Escape Game
releases.synopsis:
**It’s all fun and games until someone ends up dead.**

Six months ago, season four of The Escape Game ended in horror when contestant Alicia Angelos was found murdered on set.

Now season five is underway, and new contestants are ready to put their skills to the test solving the show's trickiest escape rooms. There's Adi, the cryptographer; Carter, the math whiz; Beck, the wannabe game master; and . . . Sierra Angelos, the girl who got away with her sister’s murder. Or so everyone believes.

But Sierra’s not just here to win. She’s here for justice.

When the contestants begin uncovering clues that hint at the identity of Alicia’s true killer, it becomes clear that the stakes aren’t high just in this competition—they’re deadly. If these teens want to win—and survive—the game, they must solve the biggest mystery of all: who killed Alicia Angelos?

releases.title: In the Periphery of It All
This House Will Feed
releases.synopsis:
Amidst the devastation of Ireland’s Great Famine, a young woman is salvaged from certain death when offered a mysterious position at a remote manor house haunted by a strange power and the horror of her own memories in this chillingly evocative historical novel braided with gothic horror and supernatural suspense for readers of Katherine Arden’s The Warm Hands of Ghosts and The Silence Factory by Bridget Collins.

County Clare, 1848: In the scant few years since the potato blight first cast its foul shadow over Ireland, Maggie O’Shaughnessy has lost everything—her entire family and the man she trusted with her heart. Toiling in the Ennis Workhouse for paltry rations, she can see no future either within or outside its walls—until the mysterious Lady Catherine arrives to whisk her away to an old mansion in the stark limestone landscape of the Burren.

Lady Catherine wants Maggie to impersonate her late daughter, Wilhelmina, and hoodwink solicitors into releasing Wilhelmina’s widow pension so that Lady Catherine can continue to provide for the villagers in her care. In exchange, Maggie will receive freedom from the workhouse, land of her own, and the one thing she wants more than a chance to fulfill the promise she made to her brother on his deathbed—to live to spite them all.

Launching herself into the daunting task, Maggie plays the role of Wilhelmina as best she can while ignoring the villagers’ tales of ghostly figures and curses. But more worrying are the whispers that come from within. Something in Lady Catherine’s house is reawakening long-buried memories in Maggie—of a foe more terrifying than hunger or greed, of a power that calls for blood and vengeance, and of her own role in a nightmare that demands the darkest sacrifice . . .

releases.title: Of Darkness and Desecration
releases.synopsis:
I could cling to hope or hate…
That night, I chose hope.
But I kept hate close by.
Just in case.

The second novel in the Harbingers of Agatharr series continues as our heroes converge.

Celeste, the Herald of Valitharr, races toward the ancient spellweaver stronghold of Lirathmar. But the divine being who whispers in her mind has been called to stand before the Pantheon, and Celeste worries she won’t survive the journey without him.

Caelen, a timid peasant, blames himself for the horrors that have befallen his loved ones and vows never to be paralyzed by fear again. His newfound eagerness finds him in possession of a powerful, ancient ability that threatens to sunder his mind unless he learns to control it.

Brynna, a hardened blacksmith, has sworn to protect Caelen and return him to the remnants of his family in Mossby. But in a world cursed with magic, even the simplest task can be marred by danger.

Their paths have merged, but how do they trust those they barely know when death lurks in every shadow?

releases.title: Love and Other Curses
releases.synopsis:
For the Kingdom. For the magic. And for love . . .

Aurelia Wycherley has found someone to tether her magic to – her enigmatic former enemy, Jules Nightly. Now, they are heading off to coven college to learn advanced magic. But they are also on a secret to discover the Lost Quarter of the college, create their own coven of twelve and try to discover a way to bring back the Old Magic. 

When malevolent magic interrupts their first night at college, Aurelia and Jules discover that Jonathan and his coven of untethered witches has escaped and now they are after her magic, curse and all… 

Can they save the magic and the world - or will Aurelia lose her magic for good?

Prepare for balls, late-night study groups, hidden mysteries, a heist, the return of old foes, and a lot more kissing!

releases.title: Oceanforged
releases.synopsis:
*From the bestselling author of The Grandest Bookshop in the World comes the second instalment of an epic fantasy adventure series in the tradition of Skandar and Percy Jackson.* 

Guided by a mysterious message, Cori, Tarn and Jem sail north to meet the secretive Loyalists, who will help them on their quest for the Oceanforged Armour.

Instead, the Loyalists warn of a looming disaster. Unless Cori can master all the powers of the Champions before it strikes, Aquinta will be doomed.

The Loyalists believe that a piece of armour may be hidden in Mutemount. But sea monsters once lurked in those waters, and no one who has travelled near the silent island in the last century has ever returned…

releases.title: The Writers Retreat
releases.synopsis:
**A wickedly twisty and atmospheric thriller set at a writers' retreat in the South of France, The Writers Retreat is Knives Out meets Anna Downes’ The Safe Place from an exciting new voice in the thriller/mystery space.**

Welcome to The Writers Retreat – a creative haven for writers to hone their plotlines and sharpen their characters while soaking up the Provençal atmosphere. But this year’s retreat offers something different, as real-life blurs with fiction, and suspense isn't contained to the page.

Kat Hale is a bestselling Australian author crumbling under the pressure of writing her second novel. On a whim, she has fled to a writers retreat in the South of France run by internationally acclaimed author Helen Thorne. What Kat hopes will be two blissfully uninterrupted weeks to focus on her writing in anonymity quickly turns into something more sinister, when Kat begins to suspect that Helen isn't quite as perfect as everyone seems to believe.

Will Kat’s drive to uncover the truth about Helen be any match for Helen’s desire to hold onto her career, her reputation and her writing retreat, or is Kat at risk of falling victim to a more dangerous climax?

releases.title: The Radiant Dark
releases.synopsis:
***Arrival meets Wild Dark Shore in this captivating novel that follows a family for over fifty years—a bold and compassionate exploration of the universe around us and what it truly means to be human.***

It’s March 1980, and Carol Girard and her husband are living an ordinary life in a small town in the Adirondacks. They have just had their first child, and though Carol is struggling with the challenges of new motherhood, her future seems clear. Until something extraordinary happens: an inexplicable flickering of light in the sky, which is ultimately determined to be communication from intelligent life on another planet. But these beings are eleven light-years away, and nothing is known about them other than the fact that they seem to know we exist too. And so begins a decades-long exchange of messages with this mysterious, faraway civilization.

As humanity reels from a shifting understanding of its place in the universe, we follow the stories of the Girard family: Carol, whose fascination with this other life sparks a desperate search for spiritual meaning; Michael, her loyal son, who finds solace not in the stars above his head but in the ground beneath his feet; and Ro, Carol’s bright and ambitious daughter, whose childhood goal to work in interstellar communication will evolve into something far grander.

Tracing five decades of love, loss, ambition, and self-discovery, *The Radiant Dark* is a stunning examination of a family navigating their lives with the knowledge that we are not alone.

releases.title: After 9th A Houston Murder Story
releases.synopsis:
The city of Houston does not sleep easily in July.

The heat lingers past midnight, rising from the asphalt in slow, invisible waves, settling over the bayous and the flatlands like a second skin. By the time the rest of the country has pulled on a light jacket and called the evening cool, Houston is still sweating — still exhaling the day's burn into a sky too thick and close to offer relief.

It was in this kind of heat that Donna died.

And it was in this heat that Bill first understood how quickly the world a man builds over a lifetime can be taken from him — not just the woman he loved, but the practice, the purpose, the very stability of his mind and body. All of it. Gone.

He was sixty-two years old when he buried her in his heart, because her family would not let him stand at her grave.

This is that story.

The Fulcrum is failing, and demons are slipping into the mortal world, stalking the night.

releases.title: Wings of Brotherhood
releases.synopsis:
Wings of Brotherhood: A Journey Between Two Air Forces by Badrul Hassan Khan is an extraordinary Pakistan Air Force memoir that takes readers inside the cockpit, command rooms, and corridors of power across South Asia and the Gulf. From fierce dogfights in West Pakistan during the 1965 war to the heartbreaking betrayals of 1971, this PAF pilot biography book reveals the courage, loyalty, and sacrifices of men who shaped aerial warfare in the region.

Wing Commander Badrul Hassan Khan, one of the rare officers to have fought in both the Indo Pak wars, offers an unfiltered look at how politics, pride, and patriotism collided in the skies. As he moves from the Pakistan Air Force to help build Bahrain’s Air Wing from scratch, readers witness the remarkable evolution of two nations’ military identities.

Packed with gripping battle scenes, behind the scenes accounts of Air Marshal Noor Khan’s leadership, and insider perspectives on military intelligence, this military memoir book captures a defining era of aviation and regional geopolitics. Whether you’re a history enthusiast, a student of Pakistan Air Force history, or simply drawn to tales of valor and vision, Wings of Brotherhood offers an unmatched journey through war, duty, and brotherhood.

A powerful addition to collections of books on the Indo Pak war 1965 and 1971, this is the definitive Pakistan Air Force memoir, a story of ambition, betrayal, and resilience that continues to shape South Asia’s skies.

releases.title: First Freedom
releases.synopsis:
Born in 1926, Opal Lee grew up in a racially divided America and dedicated her life to overcoming the obstacles presented therein. A lifelong educator, Ms. Opal has been a community activist all her life, and would take on the movement to celebrate and commemorate Juneteenth not just as a holiday, but as a symbol of comprehensive freedom for all people.

Ms. Opal’s life personifies the fight for everyday freedom that leads to lasting change. As the Grandmother of Juneteenth says, “There is so much more to do.”

releases.title: To Catch a Fascist
releases.synopsis:
A searing, provocative investigation into the rise of white nationalist and neo-Nazi movements in the United States, centered on the anti-fascist groups working to expose and stop these hateful factions.

Demonized as “extremist” by conservatives and liberals alike, “antifa” became a bogeyman during Donald Trump’s first term. But few Americans understood the dangerous work antifa was doing to disrupt and unmask a new generation of white supremacists or listened when antifa sounded the alarm about these white supremacists taking positions of power. Now this underground network of militant anti-fascists is determined to stop the rising tide of fascism in America. No matter the cost.

In the tradition of in-the-room investigative classics such as The Smartest Guys in the Room and Bad Blood, To Catch a Fascist follows different factions of antifascists as they work to unmask hateful extremists before they commit devastating acts of violence. With searing detail and exclusive reporting, To Catch a Fascist paints a vivid picture of the stakes in this ongoing, often unseen war between opposite ends of the political spectrum, highlighting the scrappy resourcefulness and resilience of anti-fascist movements against their increasingly violent adversaries. Utilizing razor-sharp storytelling and eye-opening insight, this timely and necessary book reveals the human cost, moral dilemmas, and unwavering determination involved in fighting white supremacy.

Both a call to action and a pulse-raising look at the powerful work being done to combat today’s gravest threat to democracy, To Catch a Fascist will inspire you to fight for your community.

releases.title: Intoxicated Ways of Knowing
releases.synopsis:
Intoxicating substances can be found lurking in every corner of modern life, and Matthew Perkins-McVey’s pathbreaking book offers the untold story of how they were implicated in shifting perceptions of embodiment found in the emerging sciences of the body and mind in late-nineteenth-century Germany. Their use in this experimental context gave rise to a dynamic conception of the subject within the scientific, psychological, philosophical, and sociological milieu of the era. The history of the modern biological subject, Perkins-McVey argues, turns on “intoxicated ways of knowing.”
 
Intoxicated Ways of Knowing identifies the state of intoxication as a tacit form of thinking and knowing with the body. Intoxicants force us to feel, intervening directly in our perceptional awareness, and, Perkins-McVey contends, they bring latent conceptual associations into the foreground of conscious thought, engendering new ways of knowing the world. The book unfurls how intoxicants affected nineteenth-century German science and how, ultimately, the connection between mental life and intoxication is taken up in the works of Friedrich Nietzsche, Max Weber, and Sigmund Freud, bringing the biological subject out of the lab and into the worlds of philosophy, psychoanalysis, sociology, and politics.
